title: pkg/api/ handler and middleware conventions and gotchas
answers: Why isn't chi.URLParam working for a path param?
Why does my custom middleware fire after auth is already resolved?
Should I write a new legacy SQL handler for this resource?
body:
- Path params use macaron-style web.Params(c.Req)[":uid"] with a leading colon required, this is not chi/gorilla-mux (see pkg/api/dashboard.go:69 style handlers).
- Org is always obtained via c.GetOrgID() on ReqContext; org resolution happens early in ContextHandler.Middleware (pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler.go:89), part of the global middleware chain registered in http_server.go:732. Order matters, e.g. OrgRedirect must run after it (http_server.go:735).
- CSRF middleware is global and registered before per-route auth (http_server.go:700), so CSRF failures short-circuit ahead of RBAC checks.
- Many resources are mid-migration from legacy SQL-store handlers to a k8s-apiserver/unified-storage pattern (e.g. hs.getK8sDataSourceByUIDHandler() at api.go:405, newPlaylistK8sHandler in playlist.go:28). Check whether a resource has already migrated before adding a new legacy handler.
applies: Applies to writing or modifying handlers and global middleware registration in pkg/api/. Not relevant to code outside pkg/api/ routing.
